[b]Kang Tae-shik[/b] is a tall(around 1,85 meters tall) 17 years old teenager with wavy messed black hair, which he hides behind a dark blue cap because he has no patience for doing his hair. His eyebrows are thick and his nose well defined. His whole build is muscular and defined behind his always opened black coat and darker blue shirt. He is a 2nd year highschool student of Mureng town who lives in an apartment with his mother , father and younger brother in an average middle classed family. Tae-shik also is very attached to his own clothes, when he was 12 he liked a coat his mother gave to him and grown attached to it not as a cloth but a part of himself, eventually he found a look which he liked, and started using as part of his own personal uniform, any clothes which do not follow his "style", he simply uses for sleep and does not wear during his common days, since his school does not enforce it uniform usage, he simply wears his "own uniform" every day.
[b]How he got his josang?[/b]
07-01-2025
Month day year btw.
Right the moment he was sleeping, and awake in the morning, there was an ethereal blue figure with a flowing hair weaving despite no wind, it looked at him and the first thing to say, was it name.
[i][u]Songpyeon, at service of yours[/u].[/i]
Tae-shik remained surprisingly calm as he looked at the figure, he heard about the legends of the projected souls, but never thought he'd get one, before he could properly react, the josang already moved to take some notebooks and organize them inside his backpack.
[i][u] I am you[/u].[/i]
Was all the ethereal figure said, in response, despite with a sleepy look, Tae-shik simply rolled to the opposite side of the bed.
[i]What a hell... [/i]
The josang expression moved, showing to be lesser intense, Songpyeon moved closer to Kang and pulled his shirt a little.:
[i][u]Hell? A Josang I am..[/u][/i]
Songpyeon saw a mosquito reaching close to his user's ear, and then in a quick movement, smashed it between his fingers, while saying:
[i][u]Do not annoy the young master[/u][/i]
Finally, the teenager would move his head finally in the direction of the ethereal figure.
[i]The faaaack....a josang so..?[/i]
Songpyeon tilted his head finally satisfied for a reaction from his user.
[i][u]Yes, and awakened you did, congrats.[/u][/i]
[i]Nice...I think I should say...welcome to the group then...now stop staring at me, it is weird.[/i]
...
Later when he arrived at his school, everyone was already In class, he opened the door, just to be received by his teacher, saying.
[i]Late as always, now aren't you?[/i]
[i]You're bald as ever now, aren't you , Jo-eun? [/i]
[i]Oh by the spirits, you're a lost cause...[/i]
[i]So is your hair.[/i]
[I] you should learn how to respect, a teacher as a master![/I]
[I] Respect is earned, until that time I won't give a fack.[/I]
[I] Do you really want to get suspended before the class even starts?[/I]
[I] Maybe? The principal's room is far more comfortable.[/I]
The josang of Tae-shik however, touched his master shoulders and said in a echoed voice.
[i]Young master get suspended will if provocations keeps.[/i]
Tae-shik simply rolled his eyes and muttered.
[i]I don't care[/i].
The teacher frowned.
[i]You don't care...fine, just don't keeping such lack of educations...hierarchies exist for a reason.[/i]
....
....
Later that day, Tae-shik was suspended he was sitting on the chair while Songpyeon was simply floating lying on the air adjusting his own hair, and only repeated constantly inside of the teenager's head:
[i]I [u]told you, I told you, I told you.[/u][/i]
Eventually, he stopped as the principal started saying:
[i]Once again you're being adverted due to disrespectful towards authorities...do you have anything to say about?[/i]
[i]I do not.[/i]
[i]That simple?[/i]
[i]You asked if I had anything to say about, I do not, simple as I said.[/i]
He made a pause, before the principal could speak, he proceeded.
[i]Simply because you have some thing attached to your cloth with your name(name tag, Badge) I should respect?  Nah, I won't.[/i]
A coin was put between his fingers, put in between by his josang, and he simply thrown it on the air, flipping it.

Courtyard of school.
Yoon Kang-dae, one of his friends, an average girl, saw Tae-shik arriving close to their group in the concrete benches of the courtyard, took off a stick from a tree and thrown at her friend.
[u][i]Beware[/i][/u]
Was everything the josang affirmed and moved in front of his user and grabbed the stick and crashed it into crumbles.
[i]Your josang must be very loyal.[/i]
Kang simply adjusted his hat and touched his josang on the shoulder, for the other his hand was simply floating in the air.
[i]Pretty annoying as well.[/i]
Kang-Dae laughed a little.
[i]A josang reflects it  master, now doesn't it?[/i]
Myeon Ha-Rin another of his friends who was sitting next to another classmate got up, with a small shiver going from his neck said.
[i]Your josang is weird.[/i]
[i]You're saying my inner self is weird.[/i]
[i]Both serve actually.[/i]
Tae-shik crossed his arms and looked away, in a tough face.
[i]Tsk, shut up. [/i]
Songpyeon, on the other side, while floating around was in a rather joyful smile expression, flowing his hair with his own fingers in a rather gracious move making every line of his hair to wave.
